verdict.rationale: Deel's core platform explicitly supports paying contractors across 150+ countries with compliant contracts and multi-currency payments (deel-docs-11/19/24), backed by a documented contract-creation API (deel-docs-14/21) and sandbox multi-currency testing with real exchange rates (deel-docs-29). Community evidence criticizes customer service, forced Deel Wallet terms, and trust issues, but does not concretely contradict the core capability of compliant, local-currency contractor payments. Missing for 10: independent verification of actual payout accuracy/compliance per country, and case studies beyond marketing/docs claims.
